name: Feature request
description: Propose an improvement or new feature
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []

body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: The problem
      description: What pain point does this address?
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: Your proposal
      description: Describe the solution or UX
  - type: textarea
    id: alt
    attributes:
      label: Alternatives considered
